title: Enrichment Coverage Blocker: partial lesson kernels stop exporting as clean

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow package-finalizer/digest truth repair; focused regressions plus normal local gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is driven by Project Management ZIP evidence with 9/12 enrichment coverage; another provider audit is required after deploy.

claims.summary: Project Management ZIP evidence showed a 74/C package with partial enrichment (9/12) and template fallback for lessons 6, 7, and 8.
The package finalizer converts post-recovery partial enrichment coverage into a blocker that names the missing lessons and requires repair before clean export.
The run digest now marks partial enrichment as a failed content gate instead of an info caveat, even if a ready finish state is supplied.
The release does not weaken the deep quality grader and carries forward source/research bridging, prompt-artifact audit, and texture cleanup.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify partial-enrichment packages are blocked before clean export.
Bridge retrieved source-finder/OpenAlex resources into trusted concept-linked source ledger rows and reject off-discipline readings before export.
Improve deterministic variation and repeated-phrase cleanup for slide decks, discussions, lesson plans, and Study Guides.
Keep auditing Study Guides and Course FAQ under fresh deployed code for any remaining prompt-artifact leakage.
